propositions: Parent-drift breadcrumb is skipped in live-search path when child has zero local comments due to early return at 'if not local_comments:' guard in _diff_comments before _build_parent_breadcrumb is reached

Snapshot path correctly emits breadcrumb for zero-local-comment children because snapshot carries the comment field, but live-search path (snapshot lacks comment field) never reaches breadcrumb emission logic

Fix requires extraction of comment-set resolution (_snapshot_comment_set, _live_comment_set) and breadcrumb-target logic (_breadcrumb_target) to unblock live-search fetch when breadcrumb may apply despite zero local comments
Live-search path must remain safe: client-None and fetch-failure still return no breadcrumb (bug-4292 unknown-state safety), and no unnecessary API calls when no drift or no bound ancestor exists
McCabe complexity ceiling prevents inlining fix into _diff_comments; extraction + new parent_breadcrumb.py module required to keep refactored functions under ratchet (new=0 increased=0)
